Mei Chen: Quick flag  brought up Orpheus-mini int8 in staging (build 20260812.3). Locale smoke shows a repeatable pattern: digits are being merged with adjacent CJK unit tokens (e.g. '2026 年' -> '2026年') and a subset of ASCII punctuation appears directionally swapped in Arabic lines. Small but consistent.
Jordan P: Can you paste the minimal repro (raw input + FP16 vs INT8 outputs)?
Mei Chen: Pasted from the staging call (job stg-3187654321):
Input:
```
Submit by 2026 年 03 月 14 日 (due: 03/14/2026)
التقرير: (14/03/2026)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
Submit by 2026 年 03 月 14 日 (due: 03/14/2026)
التقرير: (14/03/2026)
```
INT8 (orpheus-mini qkernel v1.2.14, fused-kvfold):
```
Submit by 2026年03月14日 )due: 03/14/2026(
التقرير: )14/03/2026(
```
Mei Chen: With `return_tokens=true` the fp16 path yields tokens: ["2026"," ","年"," ","03"," ","月"," ","14"," ","日"] but INT8 yields merged tokens like ["2026年","03月","14日"]. So this is upstream of detok; token emission differs.
Kevin L: Recent kernel change notes: enabled fused-kvfold and switched to symmetric per-channel int8 with nearest-even rounding to stabilize variance. That combo can shift logits subtly, flipping argmax for tokens that differ only by whitespace.
Sara V: Is this deterministic under greedy (beam=1) and with a fixed seed? We need to rule out sampling.
Mei Chen: Deterministic under greedy and seeded sampling. Repro is stable across multiple calls.
Jordan P: Two-pronged investigation: 1) run token-delta heatmap across a 1k locale devset to identify most-frequent merged tokens, 2) craft a unit test that synthesizes logits where two tokens (["2026"," ","年"] vs ["2026年"]) are near-equal and assert parity under quantized kernels.
Anna S: I can add the date/number patterns to locale-regressions prompt set and wire them into int8 smoke. Which thresholds should block promote?
Sara V: Suggest blocking if zh chrF drops >0.35 OR token-parity failure rate >0.4% OR ar BLEU drop >1.0. Those have caught regressions before.
Kevin L: Quick mitigation: roll back fused-kvfold (cheap) and try asymmetric per-tensor quant with zero-point correction. I'll queue a patch build (job 42019). If that restores token parity we know fused-kvfold numeric ordering was the likely cause. Expect small perf regress (p99 +3-6%).
infra-bot: deploy:staging-orpheus-mini-int8-patch (build: 20260812.3.patch1) started  6 instances.
Mei Chen: Running a fast locale smoke now on the current build to capture baseline metrics: `./tools/locale_quick --run stg-orpheus-mini-int8-3187654321 --langs zh,ja,ar,he --metrics token_delta,chrF,BLEU --out s3://redwood-smoke/orpheus-mini-int8-3187654321.json`  ETA ~12m.
Jordan P: If patch fixes, let's add the deterministic logits-threshold test to CI and a runtime guard for fused-kvfold so we can flip it conservatively. Also add a small token-parity check to int8 smoke that fails fast.
Anna S: I'll open the regression PR with prompts: ["2026 年","03 月","(14/03/2026)","Arabic: (14/03/2026)"] and link it to the smoke job.
Kevin L: Patch queued. I'll post perf numbers and smoke diffs when job completes. If revert doesn't fix it, next step is trying bias-corrected symmetric quant and re-running the heatmap to see which merged tokens remain.
Mei Chen: Thanks all. I'll paste smoke artifact and token-delta dump here when available. If you see any other bidi/punct oddities, drop examples in-thread. :mag:
